summary: NeuroOne Medical Technologies Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that it received a Nasdaq Staff letter on April 30, 2026, confirming it has regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement (Bid Price Rule). The company had previously been notified of a deficiency on May 6, 2025, and cured it by maintaining a closing bid price at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days. This is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. No special-situation event is present.
